footer_tagline: Ulwazi oluqokelelweyo lokulwa nogonyamelo olususelwa kwisini kunye nenkxaso, olwakhelwe abafazi namantombazana aseMzantsi Afrika.
footer_bottom: SafeHaven · Yakhelwe abafazi namantombazana aseMzantsi Afrika
hero_desc: I-SafeHaven idibanisa iindawo zokhuseleko, isiluleko sezomthetho, kunye nomntu onokuthetha naye kwindawo enye, yakhelwe uMzantsi Afrika, ngeelwimi ozithethayo.
how_1_text: Khangela iindawo zokhuseleko, amaziko onyango, kunye namaziko oncedo lwezomthetho ngephondo uze ubone ngqo ukuba yeyiphi into inikezela ngayo ngaphambi kokuba uhambe.
how_2_text: Izikhokelo ezicacileyo zichaza imiyalelo yokhuseleko, ukuxela ugonyamelo, kunye nento umthetho waseMzantsi Afrika okuvumela ukuba uyenze.
how_3_text: Yonke into kule webhusayithi inokuvalwa ngoko nangoko nge-Quick Exit, kwaye akukho nto ilapha egciniweyo okanye ilandelelwayo.
resource_rights_sub: Isikhokelo esinyathelo ngenyathelo sokufaka isicelo, simahla
resource_support_sub: Iminxeba yoncedo kunye neenkonzo zocweyo, nangaliphi na ixesha lemini
cta_title: Akufuneki ukuba uyisombulule le nto uwedwa.
cta_desc: Yonke into kwi-SafeHaven simahla, iyimfihlo, kwaye yenzelwe ukusebenza nakumxhaso wehlisayo kwikhwelo.
